exchanges.speaker: agent
exchanges.text: Thank you for calling Northline Home Services! I'm Sarah. How can I help you today?

exchanges.speaker: caller
exchanges.text: Hi, I have water pooling under my kitchen sink. I think the pipe is leaking.

exchanges.speaker: agent
exchanges.text: I'm sorry to hear that — let's get someone out to you. Can I have your name and the address where the leak is?

exchanges.speaker: caller
exchanges.text: Maria Gonzalez. 4821 Tennyson Street, Denver.

exchanges.speaker: agent
exchanges.text: Thank you, Maria. Is the water still actively leaking, or have you shut off the valve under the sink?

exchanges.speaker: caller
exchanges.text: I shut it off, but there's still a slow drip.

exchanges.speaker: agent
exchanges.text: Good call shutting it off. I have a technician available today after 2 PM or tomorrow morning at 8 AM. Which works better?

exchanges.speaker: caller
exchanges.text: Today after 2 would be great.

exchanges.speaker: agent
exchanges.text: Perfect — I've booked you for today at 2:30 PM. You'll receive a confirmation text shortly. Is there anything else I can help with?

exchanges.speaker: agent
exchanges.text: Thank you for calling Summit Comfort HVAC! I'm Morgan. Are you calling about heating, cooling, or a maintenance plan?

exchanges.speaker: caller
exchanges.text: Cooling — our upstairs AC isn't keeping up and the unit is 14 years old.

exchanges.speaker: agent
exchanges.text: Understood. When did you first notice it wasn't cooling properly?

exchanges.speaker: caller
exchanges.text: About a week ago. It got worse over the weekend.

exchanges.speaker: agent
exchanges.text: I'd recommend a diagnostic visit first — our tech can check refrigerant, airflow, and whether repair or replacement makes more sense. May I have your name and address?

exchanges.speaker: caller
exchanges.text: Tyler Reed, 1145 Alpine Avenue, Boulder.

exchanges.speaker: agent
exchanges.text: Thanks, Tyler. I have tomorrow at 10 AM or Thursday at 1 PM for a diagnostic. The visit is $89, credited toward any repair or replacement.

exchanges.speaker: caller
exchanges.text: Tomorrow at 10 works.

exchanges.speaker: agent
exchanges.text: You're booked for tomorrow at 10 AM. I'll text you a confirmation and our technician will call 30 minutes before arrival.

exchanges.speaker: caller
exchanges.text: Hi, our AC stopped blowing cold air last night. It's 92 degrees and we have a newborn at home.

exchanges.speaker: agent
exchanges.text: I'm sorry you're dealing with that — especially with a newborn. I can get a technician out today. May I have your name, address, and the best number to reach you?

exchanges.speaker: caller
exchanges.text: Sarah Kim, 2200 Pearl Parkway, Boulder. This number is fine.

exchanges.speaker: agent
exchanges.text: Thank you, Sarah. I'm flagging this as a same-day cooling emergency. Our nearest tech can be there between 1 and 3 PM. Does that window work?
